books.author: Eleanore Harte
books.title: The Roses of Glenmere
books.description:
When Isla Sinclair discovers a hidden letter among her late mother’s papers, it draws her north to Glenmere House—a decaying estate burdened by debt, silence, and the consequences of something that happened there years ago.

Callum MacGregor is the last of his line, struggling to preserve the house his family has nearly lost. He has no reason to trust the guarded stranger who arrives at his door in the middle of a storm, already knowing his name. But Isla carries evidence connecting her family to Glenmere: a vanished servant, a disputed boundary, and an old crime concealed beneath decades of respectable lies.

As threatening notes give way to intrusion and violence, Isla and Callum uncover a trail leading through locked rooms, altered records, and the ruined rose garden Callum’s mother kept closed. Someone knows what happened at Glenmere—and intends to ensure the truth remains buried.

Drawn together by danger and a growing tenderness neither expected, Isla and Callum must decide whether the past will finally destroy Glenmere or offer them both a place to begin again.

The Roses of Glenmere is an atmospheric historical romance about inherited guilt, buried truth, and two guarded people learning that some ruined things can still be restored.

books.author: Eleanor Harte
books.title: The Glove Shop on Market Lane
books.description:
Mollie Tremaine has spent years building a life of her own.

After her father's death, she takes over Tremaine & Co., the glove shop on Market Lane, determined to keep the business alive despite mounting debts, unreliable suppliers, and a town that doubts a young woman can manage such responsibilities alone.

When a series of unpaid accounts and troubling irregularities threaten the shop's future, Mollie has little choice but to accept help from Jory Penrose, a practical, sharp-eyed shipping agent with problems of his own. What begins as a reluctant partnership soon draws them into long days of ledgers, deliveries, market negotiations, and the quiet work of saving a business that means everything to her.

As pressures mount from creditors, competitors, and secrets buried in the town's commercial past, Mollie finds herself relying on Jory more than she ever intended. Yet trust has never come easily, and surrendering her independence may be the greatest risk of all.

Set along the Cornish coast, The Glove Shop on Market Lane is a warm and atmospheric historical romance filled with family obligations, small-town rivalries, hard-won trust, and a slow-burning love story built through shared work and quiet devotion.
